title: Register the checkout on the selected connection
when: A machine uses hosted and self-hosted universes whose numeric project IDs overlap.
need: Select the connection before project register or project-scoped work. Follow the refusal registration command when that connection has no checkout. Explicit registration imports an older flat map once under configured active_env; config reads never write or borrow a different connection map.
surface: Project register help, work-claim folder refusal and public machine-config guidance.
review: Candidate-source regressions cover colliding IDs, --env precedence, reassignment, inert legacy reads and shared-checkout cleanup. No live two-universe execution is claimed.
